title: Area formula on a countably rectifiable set for an injective C¹ immersion (Simon Ch. 3, 2.1–2.6)
statement: Let m, d, P ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1, D ⊆ ℝ^d open and G : ℝ^d → ℝ^P C¹ on D, injective on D, with DG(v) injective for every v ∈ D. Let B ⊆ D be Borel and countably m-rectifiable with H^m(B ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D (H^m = μHE[m]), and let Q assign to each v ∈ ℝ^d a linear subspace Q(v) such that, for H^m-a.e. v ∈ B, Q(v) is the approximate tangent space of B at v (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4). Then G(B) is countably m-rectifiable, H^m(G(B ∩ K)) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, and there is a Borel J : ℝ^d → [0, ∞) such that: for H^m-a.e. v ∈ B and every orthonormal family σ = (σ_0, …, σ_{m−1}) spanning Q(v), J(v) = (det[⟨DG(v)σ_i, DG(v)σ_k⟩]_{i,k})^{1/2}; ∫⁻_{G(B)} g dH^m = ∫⁻_B J(v)g(G(v)) dH^m(v) for every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]; and ∫_{G(B)} f dH^m = ∫_B J(v)f(G(v)) dH^m(v) for every f : ℝ^P → ℝ (Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (D B : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P) (Q : Euclid d → Submodule ℝ (Euclid d)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G D → InjOn G D → (∀ v ∈ D, Injective (fderiv ℝ G v)) → MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ D → CountablyRectifiable m B → (∀ K : Set (Euclid d), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μHE[m] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ v ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m B v (Q v)) → CountablyRectifiable m (G '' B) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid d), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μHE[m] (G '' (B ∩ K)) ≠ ∞) ∧ ∃ J : Euclid d → ℝ, Measurable J ∧ (∀ v, 0 ≤ J v) ∧ (∀ᵐ v ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), ∀ σ : Fin m → Euclid d, Orthonormal ℝ σ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = Q v → J v = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G v (σ i)) (fderiv ℝ G v (σ j))))) ∧ (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in G '' B, g w ∂μHE[m] = ∫⁻ v in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J v) * g (G v) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ w in G '' B, f w ∂μHE[m] = ∫ v in B, J v * f (G v) ∂μHE[m]
